title: TOPO-2D-00 shared W/R scene geometry
description: Draft structural schema. The Python geometric gate additionally recomputes source hashes, surface identity, sampling, thickness, gaps, clearance and intersections. polygon_mm is an open ordered vertex list with the closing edge last-to-first implicit; duplicated vertices are refused, including a repeated terminal first vertex. The same raw JSON bytes and SHA-256 are consumed by WaterLily and RANS. This schema confers no source-image or physics qualification.

polygon_mm.description: Open ordered vertices in mm. The last-to-first edge is implicit and subject to the same segment bounds. All duplicated vertices, including a duplicated closing endpoint, are refused. Segment lengths 0.1-1 mm, adjacent length ratio <=3, turning angle <=5 degrees except exactly two TE cap corners are independently checked by the geometric gate.

nose_thickness.description: Thick-arm diagnostic of the nose excluded from the bulk phase-core proof. Registered approximate E3 fractions and recomputed chord-projection first crossings are separately labelled; no global thickness qualification is inferred.
